llm_response.reason: The site displays classic scam characteristics: it asks intimate, highly personal questions under the guise of 'screening'; exploits psychological vulnerabilities (privacy, exclusivity, sexual discretion); provides no company info, privacy terms, or legitimate support contact; and it is hosted on a domain that is unrelated to adult services. These are markers of a scam aiming to extract further data or money from users. It does not resemble any genuine or regulated online dating/adult site, and lacks transparency and legitimacy.
